risks.risk: Visible key yellowing/wear suggests age or heavy use beyond typical cosmetic wear.

Confirmation and photos clarifying whether one or two units are being sold.
Clear photos of the full keyboard body, underside, and all ports.
Photo of included accessories (adapter, stand, sustain pedal if any).
Close-up of serial number plate for authenticity verification.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Yamaha PSR-S670 keyboard from the nameplate in two photos, but functionality, accessory completeness, and whether one or two units are involved remain unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
